title: Kennedy proposes a joint Soviet-US space program

tellings.quote: to Gorbachev that uh or to Kruef that that they have a joint Soviet US space program

plain: In 1963, President Kennedy is said to have proposed to the Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev that the two countries run a joint space program. The researcher Dan Sheehan tells Michels this without naming a source, at first saying Gorbachev by mistake. He tells it in a talk about Kennedy and UFOs, as a hint at how much Kennedy was willing to share with the Soviets.
